## Description

Please include a summary of the change, related issues, and motivation/context.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the engineering style guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code where necessary, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have updated corresponding documentation (`docs/` or `README.md`).
- [ ] My changes pass full workspace checks (`cargo test --workspace` and `npm test`).
- [ ] If this PR touches deliverables or binary protocols, version bumps follow project rules.
